messages:
nora: noticed a spike of failed canaries after yesterday's base-image rebase. failure mode: signer metadata absent and KMS unwrap errors in init hooks. attaching short log snippet.

sam: can you paste the snippet?

nora: ```
Apr 02 08:21:10 containerd: apply cgroup settings: EPERM
Apr 02 08:21:11 init-hook: signer_attach: error: PermissionDenied: projects/keystore/keys/image-signer: decrypt denied
Apr 02 08:21:11 audit: signer_id=\"\" pod=api-canary-7
```

felix: two independent things to check: (1) runtime compatibility (we shipped a glibc+systemd change that flips cgroup v2 behavior), (2) keystore IAM tightening merged on Monday might have removed key-level bindings for builder SA.

nora: i reproduced locally on a staging node with rootless config; switching NODE_CGROUP_COMPAT=legacy lets init-hook run and signer shows up.

sec-bot: vuln-scan: base-minimal:2026-04-01 has low-risk package upgrades only. No CVEs blocking rollout.

sam: good to know. felix, can you run an IAM audit for the builder service account across key bindings? prefer key-level grant if missing.

felix: ran quick check: key-level binding for serviceAccount:ci-builder@infra.svc is missing on image-signer. project-level role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter is present for infra-ci@infra.svc (not the builder SA).

nora: mitigation proposal: 1) roll canary back to previous signed digest (fast) 2) re-run canary with NODE_CGROUP_COMPAT=legacy to buy time for IAM fix 3) for IAM, add narrow key-level binding for ci-builder and open a postmortem to tighten mapping.

oncall: created INC-2466 to track rollback + customer-impact assessment: https://tickets.internal/INC-2466 — oncall will lead comms.

sam: agree. also request: emit an explicit audit event when signer attach runs (success/fail) with pod, image digest, and failure reason. currently empty signer field looks same as "hook never executed". that makes triage slow.

felix: i'll add the key-level binding now:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding image-signer \
  --location=global --keyring=signers \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-builder@infra.svc \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
I'll follow with a least-privilege review ticket.

nora: i'll trigger the rollback and then a controlled canary with NODE_CGROUP_COMPAT=legacy. posting logs and results here.

deploy-bot: rollout-monitor: canary-5021 -> ROLLBACK initiated by nora (sha256:deadbeef -> sha256:cafe1234) :white_check_mark:

oncall: monitoring signer attach audit events and node journals. will update in 10m.

felix: after this, let's add a small CI preflight for new base images that runs a rootless start and checks /proc/self/cgroup and the ability to run an unprivileged mount. I'll draft a short RFC and a preflight script.

sam: +1. also add an automated IAM diff check in keystore policy PRs so we notice removed bindings that affect builder SA.

nora: thanks everyone. keeping thread for postmortem notes.
